sections.title: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning & Generative AI
sections.hindiTitle: आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस, मशीन लर्निंग और जेनरेटिव AI

taxonomy.definition: Broad discipline of creating machines capable of simulating human intelligence and reasoning.
Subset of AI that gives systems ability to learn and improve from experience without being explicitly programmed.
Subset of ML using Multi-layered Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) inspired by the human brain.
Deep learning models (e.g. Large Language Models - LLMs, Diffusion models) capable of generating novel text, code, audio, and images.

learningParadigms.desc: Trained on labeled datasets (input paired with correct output). Used in bank credit scoring, fraud detection.
Trained on unlabeled data to discover hidden patterns, groupings, and clusters (e.g. customer segmentation, anomaly detection).
Agent learns by trial and error through reward and penalty system in dynamic environments.

sections.title: Blockchain, Distributed Ledger & CBDC (e-Rupee)
sections.hindiTitle: ब्लॉकचेन, डिस्ट्रीब्यूटेड लेजर और CBDC (डिजिटल रुपया)

blockchainBasics.definition: A decentralized, distributed, and cryptographically immutable digital ledger of transactions replicated across peer-to-peer nodes.

keyElements.name: Blocks
keyElements.desc: Containers of transactional data, timestamp, and cryptographic hash of the previous block.

keyElements.name: Genesis Block
keyElements.desc: Block 0, the very first initial block in a blockchain hierarchy.

keyElements.name: Immutability
keyElements.desc: Once recorded, data in any block cannot be altered retroactively without alteration of all subsequent blocks.

keyElements.name: Consensus Mechanisms
keyElements.desc: Proof of Work (PoW - energy intensive, Bitcoin), Proof of Stake (PoS - validator staking, Ethereum 2.0).

keyElements.name: Smart Contracts
keyElements.desc: Self-executing digital contracts with terms of agreement written directly into code lines (pioneered by Ethereum).

cbdc.name: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) - Digital Rupee (e₹)
cbdc.nature: Legal tender issued in digital form by sovereign central bank. Represents direct liability of RBI on currency balance sheet (unlike commercial bank deposits).

twoVariants.useCase: Settlement of secondary market transactions in government securities.
Public retail transactions via digital wallets distributed through commercial banks.

topics.name: Quantum Computing
topics.basicUnit: Qubit (Quantum Bit) - unlike classical bits (0 or 1), qubits can exist simultaneously in states 0 and 1.

principles.desc: Ability of quantum system to be in multiple states at once until measured.
Quantum phenomenon where pairs of qubits become linked such that state of one instantly dictates state of other regardless of distance.

topics.impactOnBanking: Threatens classical public-key cryptography (RSA/ECC broken by Shor's Algorithm); drives migration to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).

topics.name: Internet of Things (IoT)
topics.definition: Network of physical devices embedded with sensors, software, and connectivity that collect and exchange data over internet.
topics.protocols: MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport - lightweight publish/subscribe), CoAP, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).

topics.name: 5G & 6G Networks
topics.improvements: Ultra-low latency (<1 ms), high throughput (up to 10-20 Gbps), massive device density (1 million devices/km²), Network Slicing.

dimensions.desc: Vast scale of generated data (Terabytes to Zettabytes).
Unprecedented speed at which new data is generated and processed in real time.
Different formats of data (Structured SQL, Semi-structured JSON/XML, Unstructured video/logs).
Trustworthiness, accuracy, and quality of incoming data.
Actionable business insights extracted from raw data.
